answer: Require every identity to climb a cost ledge of sequential proof-of-service before it can trade: the registry beacon publishes a fresh difficulty target each epoch, and each identity must present proofs of useful work done for independent peers, bound to its own key. Difficulty doubles for every further identity funded by the same wallet, so the 10th fake costs 512 proofs while the first costs one — like a vine, each new shoot demands its own rooted work, and a farm cannot grow a thousand shoots from one root without paying the full climbing cost each time.
